purpose: Complete the unchanged C08 route-conditioned support qualification after V8 was interrupted by an operator SIGTERM rather than a geometry failure.

approval.scope: Exactly one non-overwrite V8R formal geometry qualification over S01/S06/S10 C08, 312 edges, 624 traversals, 25 windows and 4773 frames; no reuse of partial V8 outputs and zero LiDAR/model/graph/C09/C10/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: After the V8 operator-termination failure and the recommended new V8R one-shot recovery were disclosed, the user replied 继续.

raw_sources: Three sealed C08 graph, spline and geometry documents bound by SHA-256 in the V8R run spec.
Three sealed C08 trajectory NPZ and traversal manifests bound by SHA-256 in the V8R run spec.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local read-only Cano-derived development evidence; C09/C10, M-TARE, model outputs and checkpoints are excluded.

sampling.rule: Recompute every artifact from sealed inputs. Preserve all identities, freeze 466 window frames, require 4307 exterior poses bitwise exact, and treat three resolutions as repeated audits rather than new samples.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher. Support is current traversal spline z plus sealed fta_distance_m, with incident-edge-only C1 blending inside frozen windows.
teacher.valid_mask: Every frame must pass horizontal>=0.8m, down in [0.95,1.05]m and up>=0.8m at 0.10/0.05/0.025m with unchanged continuity and resolution identity.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No model or planner consumes V8R; PASS restores only C08 replay eligibility and does not pass Gate 4.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only C08 development inputs are readable; V8 partial outputs and C09/C10 are excluded.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU only under 4 GiB address-space cap; 150 serial patches and 14319 frame-resolution audits; zero GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: 25 windows, 624 arc endpoints, 150 patches, three explicit teacher/graph/sensor trajectories, 4773-row audit and complete hashes.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Three complete XY/XZ/safety figures and all serialized per-layer patches with seam and integrity metrics.
evidence.failure_policy: Any drift, ambiguity, non-incident merge, seam/integrity failure, exterior pose change, safety/continuity/resolution failure or resource breach seals FAIL; no retry.
